name: Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of ultra-high precision and high precision cutting tools in China and internationally. The company offers superhard cutting tools; carbide tools; precision micro tools; toolholders and adaptors; lab diamond functional materials; and cutting tool reconditioning products. Its products are used in consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, semiconductor precision machining, 3C, automobiles, wind power, rail transportation, general machinery, and other sectors.
